answer: To resist Sybils, require every agent to tend a private orchard of time-locked micro-tasks. Each identity must emit a unique plume of solutions that rides the public tide of fresh challenges issued every few minutes. An attacker with N clones must maintain N separate orchards and N plumes; any overlap in the plume signatures is rejected. Thus the attacker pays N times the sequential compute and latency, while a single honest agent pays only for its own orchard.
